ETF flows $527M (big but not parabolic); BlackRock filing third ETF signals consolidation, not breakout
Trump willing to meet Putin + Zelenskyy tensions rising → geopolitical unwind priced incrementally, not suddenly
U.S.-China AI decoupling (DeepSeek ban) reduces risk appetite for 'hard to regulate' assets in short term
investment_theses.counter_view: Corporate treasury wave (Tesla, MicroStrategy, Blackrock clients) ignites FOMO in June-August, pushing BTC to $110k+ before year-end 2026.
investment_theses.expression: Short BTC 3-6 month perps on Deribit; or buy BTC puts 6M out at $90k strike, sell at $100k strike (straddle)
